name: AeroCascade — Remote Tower Cybersecurity & Cascading Failure Simulator
description: Interactive discrete-event simulation engine and tripartite cybersecurity risk modeling platform for Remote Tower Operations (Aggarwal & Dhillon, AIAA Aviation 2026), integrating Dhillon & Moores (2001) controls, FMEA RPN quantification, EASA Part-IS, EUROCAE ER-040, and PSOE maturity assessment.
